decisions.reason: As the flagship waterproof lined range in a growing safety footwear market, it is a core option whose value is still being realized, and with no evidence of failure, keeping it on the market is cheap relative to its strategic upside.
ESD occupational shoes serve a steady industrial niche with certification-driven demand, so carrying the model costs little and the option stays worth holding absent signals of weak results.

A generic safety shoe series is more exposed to the routine collection turnover of footwear firms, but without archived evidence of poor performance the low cost of keeping it argues against abandoning it yet.
